BL-1752 — On a mono-router pack the chase never starts a second session to serve a role's mail - a :departing-mid-parcel refusal leaves the target role's mail for the resident, which the chase rotates once its turn ends; the chase's consult spawn (spawn-consult-session!, consult-eligible?) and the single_inference_slot knob only it read are removed
